productionChecklist.procedure: Verify target still READY and compatible before release. On regression stop newly activated workers/providers, restore reviewed application deployment, inspect migration state read-only. Preserve SEO/audit/budget data; do not drop tables or retry uncertain migrations automatically.

proposedStopConditions: Any cross-environment write or unauthorized mutation
Any unexpected paid job or outbound message
Two consecutive sitemap 5xx checks one minute apart
Sustained new 5xx or latency regression relative to release baseline
productionChecklist.rule: Use existing hosting/Supabase logs; do not enable a paid monitoring integration. Record release operator, alert recipient, baseline, RPO/RTO and approved latency/error thresholds.

Verify ownership and existing lecomax.com sitemap status, inspect representative active product/category canonicals and inactive 404s after release. Do not submit protected staging URLs. Sitemap submission, IndexNow and live indexing activation require separate authorization.
Separate approval for exact production migration package, deployment, push/merge, commerce canaries and later activation of external services
